thread:
olivia: quick preflight for tonight's regional roll. plan: US -> EU -> APAC. window 20:00-22:30 PT. canary steps 1%/3%/20%/full. APAC manual hold until EU full green.
sam: warm-pool check? any constrained zones?
diego: warm pools: US free=160/300, EU free=70/120, APAC free=22/80. APAC has scheduled cooling at 02:15 local; keep manual.
ops-bot: capacity fetch: `opsctl capacity --regions us,eu,apac --json` returns US.free=160/300, EU.free=70/120, APAC.free=22/80.
tara: monitoring thresholds set: p95 > 300ms for 5m OR error_rate > 0.8% triggers rollback. I'll be on watch.
olivia: @deploy-bot start US canary 1% with version=v1.2.3 and fallback=v1.2.2. pin for canary.
deploy-bot: canary started: id cb-1735009999 region=us percent=1 version=v1.2.3 fallback=v1.2.2.
sam: enabling KV cache prefill for canary now. command: `curl -X POST /cache/prefill -d '{"id":"cb-1735009999","regions":["us"]}'`
tara: 8m check: error_rate=0.03%, p95=190ms, CPU=66% 90% of allowed. looks fine. hold 12m before stepping.
diego: no thermal flags. EU nominal. APAC still blocked.
deploy-bot: waiting for 12m stability before US -> 3% step. next check +12m.
release-manager: draft announcement ready; will post once EU 1% kicks. includes rollback snippet and support contacts. link: https://docs.internal/releases/1735009999.
olivia: agreed. if rollback needed: cancel canary, promote v1.2.2, keep EU/APAC on hold, open incident if cross-region impact. rollback command in runbook: `redwoodctl rollout cancel cb-1735009999 && redwoodctl promote --version v1.2.2 --region us`
tara: 20m mark: US stable at 3% after step. p95=220ms, error_rate=0.12%. green to queue EU 1% but leave EU on manual go until we observe 15m.
ops-bot: snapshot: US.free=154, EU.free=69, APAC.free=22.
sam: final: APAC remains manual hold; we'll reassess after EU full. next status in 25m or on alert. :thumbsup:
